description: Read one authorization with its ID and the access token returned when it was sent, the token in an emailed link, or the agent key of the agent whose prior-authorization-submit or prior-authorization-renewal-start part call bought it: payment, status and next step, the payer's case number and its latest words (what it asked for, or its reason for a denial), the approval (units, start and end dates, authorization number), the units used and the day the next authorization is prepared, the clinical documents sent, every step with its date, route and who did it, what is happening on it right now (now_doing: one line read from its records, such as faxing the request, the payer's fax line confirmed it and we wait for its answer, or on the phone with the payer, with that record's time and live true while it happens), and each fax and status call sent to the payer with its sent, arrived and answered steps (receipts). Statuses: awaiting_payment, received (Licium has it and it is paid; it has not gone to the payer yet, sent_to_payer false), submitted (sent to the payer), pending, info_requested (what the payer asked for is in payer_note), approved (approved units, start and end dates, authorization number), denied (the reason is in payer_note), expired.

access_token.description: The access_token prior_authorization_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

agent_key.description: Instead of access_token: the agent key (lk_...) of the agent whose part call bought this authorization, or whose verified owner email is the practice email.

name: prior_authorization_status
title: Read an authorization follow-up
